context: Sho and Hina enjoy reading a small picture novel.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ひな、この小説、読みたい。
lines.en: Hina, I want to read this novel.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious opening. Quiet confidence in a small voice. No rush. The earnestness of a six-year-old who has found something that matters to him, wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate agreement. Eight-year-old enthusiasm that's inclusive, not performative. Quick warm nod in her voice. Eager to join him in this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The main character is really interesting.
lines.style: Steady, observant appreciation. Small voice, but the words land with genuine engagement. A perceptive child noticing something worth noticing. No exaggeration.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious joy. Eight-year-old warmth without trying. A simple statement that carries real delight. Natural and easy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I really want to know what happens next.
lines.style: Soft intensity building. A six-year-old pulled forward by genuine curiosity. Slight lean into the wanting. The quiet determination of needing to know.
